# rows 3-4 of a 4x4 grid; states: '.' dot, 'x' cross, '' empty
figs=[['....','....'],['....','..x '],['..x ','..x '],['.xx ','.x  ']]
def cnt(f,c): return sum(r.count(c) for r in f)
xs=[cnt(f,'x') for f in figs]; es=[cnt(f,' ') for f in figs]
assert xs==[0,1,2,3] and es==[0,1,2,3]
opts={'A':['xx  ','xx  '],'B':['.x  ','xx  '],'C':['.xx ','xx  ']}
good=[k for k,f in opts.items() if cnt(f,'x')==4 and cnt(f,' ')==4]
# option D places a cross in row 2, breaking the top rows, so it is excluded
assert good==['A']
